text:
nora: Support -> CS escalation: HeliosBio trial ingestion failing on large initial seed. Support reports bursts of 429 then 502s. AE says demo in ~30h; marked renewal at-risk. Need rapid mitigation and a short customer comm.

ben: Can someone paste recent proxy lines? Want to know if it's purely qps or runner-side OOMs. :mag:

sophia: logs: `2024-09-14T02:07:45Z WARN rate_limiter tenant=helios qps=880 limit=600` then `2024-09-14T02:08:03Z ERROR proxy upstream read timeout model-runner-5`. No 401/403. Looks like burst > tenant qps plus runner latency.

sophia: Ops options: (1) temp tenant QPS bump for tonight's seed, (2) flip route to `embed-throughput-v1` (embeddings may differ slightly), (3) ask customer to reduce concurrency/batch size. Command to bump qps: `infra tenant update-qps helios --qps 1400 --note "trial seed bump"`

nora: Prefer avoid model switch to keep vectors consistent for demo. Plan: apply temporary QPS bump + ask Helios to throttle to 4 workers and batch_size=12 for tonight. Ben, can you apply bump and monitor? I'll draft CS note.

ben: Applying bump now. infra-bot: TASK-10234 created for helios qps bump. QPS bump applied at 1758152040. Autoscale provisional rule set for model-runner-5 (cpu>70%).

pager-bot: Incident INC-20240914-88 opened by sophia — priority=P1 — Helios ingest throttling. PagerDuty notified. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240914-88

nora: Draft customer message (send in 5m): "Hi Helios team  we're seeing throttling on large imports. For tonight, could you reduce parallel workers to 4 and batch_size to 12? We're applying a temporary capacity bump on our side and will confirm when ingestion stabilizes. Expect an update in 20m." Thoughts?

sophia: Add ETA: confirm in 20m, target full resolution in 3 hours. Also note we won't reprocess already-completed vectors to avoid duplicates.

nora: Sent at 1758152050. Customer ACKed and will throttle. They asked: will embeddings change if you bump capacity?

sophia: Reply to customer: bump does NOT change model weights; embeddings unchanged unless we flip models. Sending now.

ben: 5m check @1758152360: error spikes reduced to near zero, occasional 429s <1/min, CPU on model-runner-5 spiked then recovered after autoscale. Keeping monitors for 3 hours.

nora: AE notified and renewal-risk flagged. Action owners: TASK-10234 -> ben (ops), customer follow-up -> nora (CS), postmortem + infra request for pre-warm -> sophia (infra/PM).

sophia: Postmortem requests: timeline, customer impact, mitigation steps, long-term fixes (ingest pre-warm, qps smoothing, guidance for large batched seeds).

nora: Closing CS handoff for now. Will attach incident and transcript to renewal-playbook and schedule post-demo recap. Reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
